maddeler.e:
أقتلع (form VIII)
# أَقْتَلِعُ (ʔaqtaliʕu) /ʔaq.ta.li.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# أُقْتَلَعُ (ʔuqtalaʕu) /ʔuq.ta.la.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# أَقْتَلِعَ (ʔaqtaliʕa) /ʔaq.ta.li.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# أُقْتَلَعَ (ʔuqtalaʕa) /ʔuq.ta.la
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
